blocks.zh: 刚开始学习电磁学时就听说过保角变换法，可是直接看复变函数/电动力学中的保角变换部分过于困难，知乎上又少有对如何使用保角变换法解决静电场问题的介绍，因此我也一直没有机会了解这种高端的方法。这次质心冬令营讲解了一些相关内容，我便根据自己的理解，将保角变换法的相关内容记录于此文中。
blocks.en: I heard about conformal mapping when I first started learning electromagnetism. But jumping straight into the conformal-mapping sections of complex analysis or electrodynamics was too hard, and there was not much on Zhihu about actually using it to solve electrostatics problems. So I never really got a chance to learn this fancy technique. This time, the Zhixin physics Olympiad winter camp covered some of it, and I thought I would write down what I understood here.

blocks.zh: 解析函数
blocks.en: Analytic Functions

blocks.zh: 解析/全纯函数是复变函数中的一个基本概念，它指的是复平面上处处可微的一类复变函数。
blocks.en: Analytic, or holomorphic, functions are a basic concept in complex analysis: complex functions that are differentiable everywhere on the complex plane.

blocks.zh: 解析函数需要满足柯西-黎曼条件。简单地说（无视严谨性），复平面上可微，就是说极限 \(\lim_{\Delta z \rightarrow 0} \frac{f(z+\Delta z)-f(z)}{\Delta z}\) 要存在，其中 \(z=x+iy, \ \ \ \ x, y \in \mathbb{R}\) ， \(f(z)=\phi(z)+i\psi(z), \ \ \ \phi(z),\psi(z)\in\mathbb{R}\) 。
blocks.en: An analytic function must satisfy the Cauchy–Riemann conditions. Roughly speaking, and never mind rigor for a moment, being differentiable on the complex plane means that the limit \(\lim_{\Delta z \rightarrow 0} \frac{f(z+\Delta z)-f(z)}{\Delta z}\) exists, where \(z=x+iy, \ \ \ \ x, y \in \mathbb{R}\) and \(f(z)=\phi(z)+i\psi(z), \ \ \ \phi(z),\psi(z)\in\mathbb{R}\).

blocks.zh: 把 \(z\) 和 \(f\) 代入，将分子凑出因子 \(\Delta x+i\Delta y\) 之后，即可得到柯西-黎曼条件： \(\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}\) 。
blocks.en: Substitute \(z\) and \(f\) and rearrange the numerator to factor out \(\Delta x+i\Delta y\). This gives the Cauchy–Riemann conditions: \(\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}\).

blocks.zh: 这个条件很有意思，他实际上说明了 \(\phi, \psi\) 都满足拉普拉斯方程，以 \(\phi\) 为例： \(\nabla^2 \phi = \frac{\partial^2 \phi}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \phi}{\partial y^2} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}=0\) 。
blocks.en: This is an interesting condition: it actually tells us that \(\phi, \psi\) both satisfy Laplace’s equation. Taking \(\phi\) as an example: \(\nabla^2 \phi = \frac{\partial^2 \phi}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \phi}{\partial y^2} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \phi}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}=0\).

blocks.zh: 因此，我们便可以将电势作为其中的一个，比如 \(\phi(z)\) 。
blocks.en: We can therefore take the electric potential to be one of them, say \(\phi(z)\).

blocks.zh: 保角变换
blocks.en: Conformal Mapping

blocks.zh: 找一个性质比较好的映射 \(z^\prime: \mathbb{C} \rightarrow\mathbb{C}\) ，把原复平面上的点 \(z\) 映射至一个新的点 \(z^\prime(z)\) 。
blocks.en: Find a reasonably well-behaved mapping \(z^\prime: \mathbb{C} \rightarrow\mathbb{C}\) that takes a point \(z\) in the original complex plane to a new point \(z^\prime(z)\).

blocks.zh: 此时原复平面上的边界及电势 \(\Sigma_i, \phi(z)\) 也会映射到新的边界和电势 \(\Sigma^\prime_i, \phi^\prime(z^\prime)\) 。
blocks.en: The boundary and potential \(\Sigma_i, \phi(z)\) in the original complex plane are then mapped to a new boundary and potential \(\Sigma^\prime_i, \phi^\prime(z^\prime)\).

blocks.zh: 如果我们使新的边界条件与原边界条件相同，由于电势均满足拉普拉斯方程，于是就会有 \(\phi(z)=\phi^\prime(z^\prime)\) 。
blocks.en: If we impose the same boundary conditions in the new plane as in the original one, then, since both potentials satisfy Laplace’s equation, we have \(\phi(z)=\phi^\prime(z^\prime)\).

blocks.zh: 若选取合适的映射 \(z^\prime\) ，将原来复杂的边界映射到简单边界，在新复平面中解出电势 \(\phi^\prime\) ，再回到原复平面中，即可得到原来待求解的电势 \(\phi\) 。
blocks.en: Choose a suitable mapping \(z^\prime\) to turn a complicated boundary into a simple one, solve for the potential \(\phi^\prime\) in the new complex plane, and then map back to the original plane. This gives the potential we wanted, \(\phi\).

blocks.zh: 这就是保角变换解决平面静电学问题的基本思路。
blocks.en: That is the basic idea behind using conformal mapping to solve two-dimensional electrostatics problems.

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，对于一般的三维问题，只要其具有某一方向上的平移对称性，即可转化为平面问题。
blocks.en: One thing to note: a general three-dimensional problem can be reduced to a two-dimensional problem as long as it has translational symmetry in some direction.

blocks.zh: 用 \(A=\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}\) 刻画变换前后长度的变化，
blocks.en: Use \(A=\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}\) to describe how lengths change under the transformation.

blocks.zh: 则变换前后的电场满足 \(E^\prime=-\frac{\text{d}\phi^\prime}{\text{d}z^\prime}=-\frac{\text{d}\phi}{\text{d}z}/\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}=E/\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}=E/A\) 。
blocks.en: The electric fields before and after the transformation then satisfy \(E^\prime=-\frac{\text{d}\phi^\prime}{\text{d}z^\prime}=-\frac{\text{d}\phi}{\text{d}z}/\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}=E/\frac{\text{d}z^\prime}{\text{d}z}=E/A\).

blocks.zh: 电荷量不变，线电荷密度由于线方向垂直于纸面，故不发生改变，面电荷密度则有 \(\sigma^\prime=\sigma/A\) 。
blocks.en: Charge is unchanged. The line charge density is also unchanged, because the line runs perpendicular to the page. The surface charge density, on the other hand, satisfies \(\sigma^\prime=\sigma/A\).

blocks.zh: 电容 \(C=\frac{Q}{\Delta\phi}\) 不变。
blocks.en: The capacitance \(C=\frac{Q}{\Delta\phi}\) is unchanged.

blocks.zh: 一些常见的保角变换
blocks.en: Some Common Conformal Mappings

blocks.zh: 我们可以先从一些常见的函数入手：
blocks.en: We can start with a few familiar functions:

blocks.zh: 幂函数 \(z^\prime=z^n\)
blocks.en: Power functions \(z^\prime=z^n\)

blocks.zh: 复数 \(z=re^{i\theta}\) ，经过变换得到 \(z^\prime=r^ne^{in\theta}\) 。
blocks.en: The complex number \(z=re^{i\theta}\) becomes \(z^\prime=r^ne^{in\theta}\) under this transformation.

blocks.zh: 考察这样的一类边界：
blocks.en: Consider a boundary like this:

blocks.zh: 角边界
blocks.en: A corner boundary

blocks.zh: 经过变换后， \(\Sigma_1\) 仅伸缩不旋转， \(\Sigma_2\) 伸缩后辐角变为 \(n\theta\) 。
blocks.en: Under the transformation, \(\Sigma_1\) is stretched but not rotated, while \(\Sigma_2\) is stretched and its argument becomes \(n\theta\).

blocks.zh: 如果我们选取 \(n=\frac{\pi}{\theta}\) ，那么角就会被拉平。
blocks.en: If we choose \(n=\frac{\pi}{\theta}\), the corner is flattened out.

blocks.zh: 如果原平面 \(\alpha\) 角处有一线电荷密度为 \(\lambda\) 的均匀带电长直导线，我们想要求解电势、电场分布以及导线受力，原本需要暴算无限发散电像法，现在就可以应用保角变换 \(z^\prime=z^{\pi/\theta}\) ，使得问题转化为：
blocks.en: Suppose a long, straight, uniformly charged wire with line charge density \(\lambda\) lies at the angle \(\alpha\) in the original plane, and we want the potential, electric-field distribution, and force on the wire. Originally, this would call for a brute-force, endlessly proliferating construction of image charges. Now we can apply the conformal mapping \(z^\prime=z^{\pi/\theta}\) and turn the problem into this:

blocks.zh: 把角拉平
blocks.en: Flattening the corner

blocks.zh: 接下来只需要在平面下方作出对称的一个电像即可解得 \(\phi^\prime, E^\prime\) ，于是就得到 \(\phi=\phi^\prime, E=AE^\prime\) ，问题解决。
blocks.en: All that remains is to place a single symmetric image charge below the plane to find \(\phi^\prime, E^\prime\). We then have \(\phi=\phi^\prime, E=AE^\prime\). Problem solved.

blocks.zh: 对数函数 \(z^\prime=\ln z\)
blocks.en: Logarithmic functions \(z^\prime=\ln z\)

blocks.zh: 复数 \(z=re^{i\theta}\) ，经过变换得到 \(z^\prime=\ln{r} +i\theta\) ，即横坐标变为 \(\ln r\) ，纵坐标变为 \(\theta\) 。
blocks.en: The complex number \(z=re^{i\theta}\) becomes \(z^\prime=\ln{r} +i\theta\): the horizontal coordinate becomes \(\ln r\) and the vertical coordinate \(\theta\).

blocks.zh: 考察这样的一类边界，我们想要求解其电容：
blocks.en: Consider the following boundary. We want to find its capacitance:

blocks.zh: 不平行极板
blocks.en: Nonparallel plates

blocks.zh: 经过变换后，变为间距 \(\theta\) ，板宽 \(\ln{{R_2}}-\ln{{R_1}}\) 的两平行极板，问题一下子就简单了很多，解决后再变换回来即可。
blocks.en: The transformation turns it into two parallel plates separated by \(\theta\), with plate width \(\ln{{R_2}}-\ln{{R_1}}\). Suddenly the problem is much simpler. Solve it, then transform back.

blocks.zh: 指数函数 \(z^\prime=e^z\) 则恰恰相反，把带状区域映射为角型区域。
blocks.en: The exponential function \(z^\prime=e^z\) does exactly the reverse: it maps a strip into a wedge.

blocks.zh: 反演映射 \(z^\prime=\frac{1}{z}\)
blocks.en: Inversion \(z^\prime=\frac{1}{z}\)

blocks.zh: 考察复平面上的一个圆及其内部 \(\rho\leq2r \cos\theta\) ，经过变换得到 \(z^\prime=\frac{1}{\rho e^{i\theta}}=\frac{1}{2r}\frac{e^{-i\theta}}{\cos(-\theta)}=\rho^\prime e^{i\theta^\prime}\) ，于是 \(\theta^\prime=-\theta,\ \ \ \rho^\prime cos\theta^\prime =x^\prime\geq \frac{1}{2r}\) ，即直线 \(x^\prime=\frac{1}{2r}\) 及其右侧。
blocks.en: Consider a circle and its interior in the complex plane, \(\rho\leq2r \cos\theta\). The transformation gives \(z^\prime=\frac{1}{\rho e^{i\theta}}=\frac{1}{2r}\frac{e^{-i\theta}}{\cos(-\theta)}=\rho^\prime e^{i\theta^\prime}\), and hence \(\theta^\prime=-\theta,\ \ \ \rho^\prime cos\theta^\prime =x^\prime\geq \frac{1}{2r}\): the straight line \(x^\prime=\frac{1}{2r}\) and the region to its right.

blocks.zh: 该变换可以将圆边界变换为直线边界。
blocks.en: This transformation turns a circular boundary into a straight one.

blocks.zh: 读者可以通过借此证明球面电像法小试牛刀。
blocks.en: Try your hand at using this to prove the image-charge construction for a sphere.

blocks.zh: 反演变换的推广是分式型变换 \(z^\prime=\frac{az+b}{cz+d}\) 。
blocks.en: A generalization of inversion is the linear fractional transformation \(z^\prime=\frac{az+b}{cz+d}\).

blocks.zh: 三角函数 \(z^\prime=\sin z\)
blocks.en: Trigonometric functions \(z^\prime=\sin z\)

blocks.zh: 变换后 \(z^\prime=\sin(x+iy)=\sin x\cos iy+\cos x\sin iy=\sin x\cosh y+i\cos x\sinh y=x^\prime+iy^\prime\) ，所以有 \(x^\prime=\sin x\cosh y, ~y^\prime=\cos x\sinh y\)，此为双曲坐标系的标准形式 。
blocks.en: After the transformation, \(z^\prime=\sin(x+iy)=\sin x\cos iy+\cos x\sin iy=\sin x\cosh y+i\cos x\sinh y=x^\prime+iy^\prime\), so \(x^\prime=\sin x\cosh y, ~y^\prime=\cos x\sinh y\), the standard form of hyperbolic coordinates.

blocks.zh: 故当 \(y=const.\) ，即原边界为一水平直线时，新边界为一椭圆；
blocks.en: Thus, when \(y=const.\)—when the original boundary is a horizontal line—the new boundary is an ellipse;

blocks.zh: 当 \(x=const.\) 时，新边界为双曲线。
blocks.en: when \(x=const.\), the new boundary is a hyperbola.

blocks.zh: 因此，可以用(反)三角函数实现直线、椭圆、双曲线之间的互换。
blocks.en: So trigonometric functions and their inverses let us transform between straight lines, ellipses, and hyperbolas.
Composition

blocks.zh: 通过上述几种基本的保角变换，可以通过连续的多次变换处理更为复杂的边界。
blocks.en: By applying these basic conformal mappings in succession, we can handle more complicated boundaries.

blocks.zh: 如果有什么边界是一次保角变换简化不了的，那就做两次。
blocks.en: If there is a boundary you cannot simplify with one conformal mapping, do two.
